narrative.northStar: A photographic guide with Liquid Glass navigation
narrative.overview: Warm cream reading surfaces and natural autumn photographs connect every sightseeing stop to sourced transport, costs, tips, and its itinerary date.
keyCharacteristics: Glossy translucent navigation, buttons, and badges with solid cream content panels
Fixed light appearance regardless of system theme, with reduced-transparency fallbacks
One guide per sightseeing stop with shared park costs clearly identified
Geist typography and locally hosted destination photographs
rules: The CSS tokens in src/style.css are authoritative.
Preserve all 14 dates and the 13-night total; explicit traveler revisions take precedence over the archived PDF.
The first overnight is Chengdu on 8 November; Jiuzhaigou has one night on 9 November after a morning transfer and shorter visit with entry before the published 14:00 admission cutoff.
Never claim a photo is newer or more location-specific than its source proves.
Keep the page light when the device requests dark mode.
dos: Keep visible focus and native dialog behavior.
Display practical sources, publication dates, and the research check date without requiring a disclosure click.
donts: Do not use glass inside glass.
Do not autoplay or animate distortion.
Do not count shared park tickets once per stop.
